common.medianRule: Sort raw uint64 samples ascending. For an odd count use the middle sample; for an even count use the exact arithmetic mean of the two middle samples with no rounding before threshold comparison.

portablePackageRecipe.measurement: Create the two-entry evidence-only normalized contribution archive twice and require byte-identical SHA-256. Subtract the byte length of an empty archive made by the same recipe so only entry-local, compressed-data, and central-directory bytes attributable to the candidate are counted.
portablePackageRecipe.productTopologyRule: The normalized adapter entry measures candidate code without asserting that a source-static winner ships a separate runtime DLL; the final lock still controls source-static versus private-dynamic product topology.

measurements.scenario: Create a configured 120x40 terminal, begin and end one empty render snapshot, then reach the callback-free destruction quiet point.
Feed the exact deterministic 8 MiB mixed UTF-8 and VT payload in the corpus chunk schedule without snapshot work.
Copy one complete immutable 120x40 cell and static-image snapshot under the proven begin/end sequence.
Mutate exactly two rows and one cursor state, then copy the minimal immutable changed generation.
Reflow 10000 deterministic wrapped lines from 120x40 to 80x50 and back.
Admit, decode if required, snapshot, and delete one generated 1024x1024 RGBA image while retaining exact reservation telemetry.
Feed 1 MiB to each of eight sessions in round-robin 4096-byte chunks, publish one snapshot each, and tear all sessions down.
Measure engine plus adapter-owned retained CPU bytes after the eight-session storm has quiesced and before teardown.
Measure the exact portable-package contribution using the frozen clean Release package recipe.
Count the generated public-boundary identity records using the frozen anchor rule.
Count distinct app-local runtime leaves from the verified recursive load closure.

crossLane.functionalRule: Every mandatory fixture must pass x64 Release, x64 ASan Debug, and native ARM64 Release unless a fixture is explicitly architecture-identity-only.
crossLane.performanceRule: Scores use native x64 Release samples. ARM64 Release samples are retained as regression evidence and must remain bounded but are not cross-machine score inputs.
crossLane.artifactRule: Architecture, imports, exports, public headers, capabilities, licenses, and source/tool/dependency locks must match their platform-specific frozen records.
